title: TRIDENT and SHAKTI: A Framework and Benchmark for Hindi AI-Text Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.41232v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) become increasingly multilingual, distinguishing human-written from AI-generated text is essential for maintaining information integrity. However, research remains English-centric, with limited benchmarks for low-resource languages such as Hindi. To address this gap, we introduce SHAKTI, a large-scale Hindi benchmark covering four genres, eight LLM families, multiple prompting strategies, and adversarial transformations. We evaluate its quality through human annotation and analyze linguistic, grammatical, and sentiment-based differences between human- and AI-generated texts. Building on these findings, we propose TRIDENT, a round-trip translation-based detection framework with three variants: TRIDENT-S (static threshold), TRIDENT-D (dynamic threshold), and TRIDENT-C (logistic regression using multi-distance RTT features). translated_title: TRIDENT与SHAKTI：面向印地语AI文本检测的框架与基准
translated_abstract: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）日益走向多语言化，区分人类撰写文本与AI生成文本对于维护信息完整性至关重要。然而，相关研究仍以英语为中心，针对印地语等低资源语言的基准十分有限。为填补这一空白，我们提出了SHAKTI，一个大规模印地语基准，涵盖四种文体、八个LLM家族、多种提示策略以及对抗性变换。我们通过人工标注评估了其质量，并分析了人类文本与AI生成文本在语言学、语法和情感层面的差异。基于这些发现，我们提出了TRIDENT，一个基于往返翻译（round-trip translation）的检测框架，包含三个变体：TRIDENT-S（静态阈值）、TRIDENT-D（动态阈值）和TRIDENT-C（使用多距离RTT特征的逻辑回归）。TRIDENT利用原始文本与往返翻译文本之间的语义一致性来（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文针对低资源语言AI文本检测研究不足的问题，提出了大规模印地语AI文本检测基准SHAKTI，以及基于往返翻译语义一致性的三变体检测框架TRIDENT。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SHAKTI, a large-scale Hindi benchmark for AI-text detection, and TRIDENT, a round-trip translation-based detection framework with three variants, addressing the gap in AI-text detection research for low-resource languages.
